intro: The sales chain, link by link. Every step has an alert threshold: a link that drops off is visible before the result.

glossary.title: Link
glossary.definition: A measured step of the sales chain (Acquisition, Conversation, Qualification…), with its own alert threshold: a link that drops off is visible before the result.

coverageWhy: The others are waiting for data: they stay grey, never red.
coverageNone: That is expected on a workspace that is just starting: the tiles fill in as you go, and nothing turns red until something has actually flowed.
alertsGoTo: {{count}} alert — go to the link that is dropping off
alertsGoTo_other: {{count}} alerts — go to the links that are dropping off, one by one

learning.title: What works best for you
learning.intro: What your team did with its past needs. These counts prioritise your next analyses — all else equal, offers that already converted here come first.
learning.empty: Nothing yet: no need has been moved (converted, turned into an action or marked obsolete). The loop stays silent as long as there is nothing to learn.
learning.dataUsed: Based on needs your team moved by hand — converted, turned into an action or marked obsolete. Since your workspace opened: this count is not limited to any window.
learning.tooFewMoves: Too few moves to read a trend: at least {{count}} on a single pattern are needed. These counts stay true, they do not yet say what works.

pipeline.title: CRM pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: Computed from your CRM history, not from an estimate.
pipeline.notConnected: No CRM is connected to this workspace. Nothing is shown rather than an empty pipeline.
pipeline.scopeMissing: I am not allowed to read your CRM. Reconnect it: access already granted does not widen on its own.
pipeline.authorizationExpired: Your CRM is still connected, but its authorisation has expired. Reconnect it from Settings › Integrations: it will not renew on its own.
pipeline.failed: Your CRM did not answer. This is not “your pipeline is empty”: the read failed.
pipeline.outcomeUnknown: {{count}} closed deal with no readable outcome — neither won nor lost
pipeline.outcomeUnknown_other: {{count}} closed deals with no readable outcome — neither won nor lost
pipeline.truncated: read stopped at its bound, the pipeline is larger than what is shown

finance.title: Finance and capacity
finance.subtitle: Five readings, never merged into one figure. The gap between them is the information.
finance.forbidden: These figures belong to the finance scope. They exist, but your seat cannot read them.
finance.unavailable: Could not read. Nothing is shown rather than a figure at zero.
finance.floor: {{count}} line without an amount — the total is a floor
finance.floor_other: {{count}} lines without an amount — the total is a floor
finance.noAmount: {{count}} line exists, and it carries no amount. This is not “zero euros”.
finance.noAmount_other: {{count}} lines exist, none carries an amount. This is not “zero euros”.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.hint: Four figures saying four different things. Adding them up would mean nothing.

tooltip.signed: Counts missions SIGNED in the period, at their contractual amount. Excludes days delivered, what was invoiced and what was collected — the three other lines.
tooltip.produced: Days actually worked × daily rate, over the period shown. Excludes missions without a daily rate, which leave the total and are counted separately.
tooltip.invoiced: What went out to the accounting tool in the period. Excludes months not yet invoiced.
tooltip.collected: What the client actually paid in the period. Excludes invoices still awaiting payment.

reasons.no_source: No source for this figure in the chosen period — invoicing tracking has recorded nothing for that month. This is not « zero euros ».
reasons.no_source_screen: No source for this figure in the chosen period — invoicing tracking has recorded nothing for that month. This is not « zero euros »: the Collections card below reads that same tracking over the last twelve months.
reasons.no_amount: Rows exist, none carries an amount. The figure stays unknown.
reasons.unavailable: Read failed. Nothing is shown rather than a zero.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.hint: Three lines, no weighting: this quarter's probable revenue, calibrated deal by deal, lives on the pipeline.

tooltip.secured: Missions in progress, up to their known end date. Excludes the sales pipe and renewals not yet engaged.
tooltip.likely: Renewals where a step has already happened (a proposal sent, a verbal agreement). Excludes the pipe not yet engaged, and carries no probability weighting.
tooltip.hoped: The sales pipe, at its nominal amount. Excludes any weighting tied to how likely a signature is — never a weighted figure.
tooltip.contractedMargin: The margin of the missions ALREADY SIGNED over the horizon — their day rate and loaded cost are recorded, nothing is guessed. Excludes the “hoped” line entirely: a pipeline deal has no cost, and lending it the others’ margin would be a hypothesis. No weighting of any kind: every contracted mission counts at its real rate.

forecast.contractedMarginAbsent: not served by this server version
forecast.contractedMarginUnmeasured_one: {{count}} mission has no recorded cost, left out
forecast.contractedMarginUnmeasured_other: {{count}} missions have no recorded cost, left out

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.hint: How many days the team can still sell this month.
capacity.benchNotMeasurable: not measurable — {{have}} consultant out of the {{need}} needed

tooltip.capacityDays: Working days in the month × number of people on the team. Excludes people whose assignment could not be read, counted separately.
tooltip.committedDays: Days already committed to signed missions this month. Excludes the sales pipe, which is not sold yet.
tooltip.benchRate: Consultants without an active assignment, ÷ consultants counted, subject to the measurability threshold. Excludes consultants not counted.
tooltip.availableDays: What is left to sell = days available − days committed. Excludes the whole computation as soon as one of the two terms is missing.

margin.title: Margin
margin.hint: Weighted by days: a one-day mission does not weigh the same as a one-year one.
margin.unmeasuredShareNone: no mission to measure this month
margin.unmeasuredShareNote: share of missions whose margin cannot be computed
margin.notEnough: target not compared — {{have}} mission of the {{need}} needed
margin.notEnough_other: target not compared — {{have}} missions of the {{need}} needed

tooltip.aggregate: Margin weighted by the days declared, over the period shown. Excludes missions without a daily rate or a loaded cost, counted separately.
tooltip.unmeasuredShare: The share of missions whose margin could not be computed, as a percentage of the whole. Excludes the margin itself — it measures our own blind spot, not financial health.
tooltip.threshold: The threshold below which a mission triggers a COMMERCIAL margin alert — set from Settings › Finance. Excludes missions without a known cost, which can never be compared against it.
tooltip.base: The number of missions the margin above is computed on, for the period shown. Excludes missions with no daily rate or loaded cost: they are counted separately.

dso.title: Payment delay
dso.hint: A median, over paid invoices only: one invoice settled after legal action does not move the whole portfolio. A dispute is not a late payment — contested invoices are left out, and counted separately.
dso.needMore: not measurable — {{count}} invoice out of the {{need}} needed
dso.needMore_other: not measurable — {{count}} invoices out of the {{need}} needed
dso.undatable: {{count}} invoice set aside for missing dates
dso.undatable_other: {{count}} invoices set aside for missing dates

tooltip.days: The median payment delay, over paid invoices across the WHOLE history. Excludes contested invoices and invoices still unpaid, counted separately.

channels.title: Margin by channel
channels.hint: The gap between direct and going through an intermediary: this is what justifies a referencing effort, or not.
channels.gapUnknown: one of the two margins is missing

tooltip.margin: The average margin of this channel's missions, weighted by their days, over the period shown. Excludes missions without a daily rate or a loaded cost, counted separately.
tooltip.gap: The margin gap between the direct channel and the intermediated one, in points. Excludes the comparison as soon as one of the two margins is not measurable.

scope.own: Your perimeter: your accounts and your missions.
scope.outside_one: {{count}} mission belongs to nobody and is in no total.
scope.outside_other: {{count}} missions belong to nobody and are in no total.

finance.restricted: Managers only: this figure covers the whole workspace.

screen.outOfPeriod: The forecast, the capacity and the payment delay do not follow this period: they look ahead, at the current month, and across the whole history.

alerts.title: What is holding money back
alerts.hint: What to do today, from the most blocking to the least. These amounts do not add up: it is the same money seen through several blockers.
alerts.floor_one: including {{count}} with no amount — the total is a floor
alerts.floor_other: including {{count}} with no amount — the total is a floor

target.title: Attainment
target.none: No target set. No percentage until someone sets one — “0%” would be a claim.
target.marginUnknown: This month’s margin could not be computed: nothing to compare.
target.marginNotEnough: Too few priced missions to compare: two missions carry no verdict.
target.saveFailed: Could not save. Nothing was changed.
target.invalid: A target sits between 1 and {{max}}%. Leave it empty to clear the month’s target.
target.hint: One target per month. Leaving it empty clears it: the ring goes quiet rather than showing a target nobody stands behind.

introducers.title: Introduced business
introducers.hint: What going through an introducer costs, in margin points.
introducers.forecastAbsent: Forecast: not measured. Nothing in the product computes a forecast margin — the forecast is revenue, deliberately unweighted. Inventing one here would be a fabricated figure.

timesheets.title: Timesheets
timesheets.hint: Three states, not eight: on a dashboard the only question is what blocks a month of invoicing.
timesheets.notRequired_one: {{count}} on a fixed price, out of the count
timesheets.notRequired_other: {{count}} on a fixed price, out of the count
timesheets.unclassified_one: {{count}} in a state not grouped here

adv.title: Sales administration
adv.hint: This month’s files, and what keeps them from being invoiceable.
adv.renewalsNoDelta: No comparison possible: renewals to act on are computed against today, not against a month.
adv.queueEmpty: No reason is blocking a file this month.
adv.reserved_one: {{count}} reason not measured yet — it is not counted as zero.
adv.reserved_other: {{count}} reasons not measured yet — they are not counted as zero.
adv.startsNoDelta: No comparison: the reference month could not be counted. That is not “the same as before”.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.hint: What moved, most recent first. The band above says what to do; this one says whether it is moving.
activity.empty: Nothing moved over the period read.

kinds.timesheet_rejected: Timesheet sent back to its author

notDated.invoice_sent: “Invoice sent” will not appear: the product issues no invoices.
notDated.payment_received: “Payment received” does not appear: collections are known as monthly amounts, with no event date.

entities.label: Company
entities.hint_one: {{count}} company recorded. Pick it to keep only what it carries.
entities.hint_other: {{count}} companies recorded. Pick one to keep only what it carries.
entities.blind: Three blocks do not follow this company and stay on the whole workspace: {{blocks}}.

toTreat.withoutClient_other: {{count}} invoices to handle with no client attached.

learning.title: Rules learned from losses
learning.intro: A rule only comes from at least two documented losses. A manager rules on it; adopting does not activate it — activation is a second step, and deactivating it removes it from what {{copilot}} knows.
learning.unavailable: Can’t be read. This is not “no rule”: the learned rules could not be loaded.
learning.needTwoRex: No learned rule: at least two documented losses are needed to propose one.
learning.none: No learned rule yet. Cite at least two similar losses to propose one.
learning.adoptedToast: Proposal adopted — the rule is created, disabled, awaiting activation review.
learning.proposed: Proposal saved — a manager has to rule on it.

propose.needTwo: Pick at least two similar losses.
propose.observation: What these losses have in common (one sentence)

follow.measure_other: {{count}} actions followed · {{positive}} positive · {{negative}} negative · {{open}} without a declared outcome
follow.contradicted: Your results contradict it: no positive outcome across several actions. Deactivating it is up to you.

tace.title: TACE · utilisation rate
tace.intro: Billed days ÷ available working days. Weekends, public holidays and leave are removed from the denominator.
tace.formula: TACE = billed days ÷ available working days. Available working days = days of the month excluding weekends, French public holidays and the consultant's leave/absences. Planned: days from assignments (load %). Actual: days entered in timesheets.
tace.noThreshold: No alert threshold set: no alert until the firm sets one.
